app/src/server/pokeapi.ts:96 — toCards takes an extra() callback, a real seam that absorbed the 'hidden ability' variant (functions.ts:188)

abstraction_design.rationale: The shared abstractions (card list with renderAction, toCards with extra, Section, MoveTable) are sized to the app's real variation and stretched to the later feature without duplication; the cost is that per-resource pages are hand-rolled and small mapping logic is repeated.

findings.issue: CardData is built in three independent places (getTeamData here, toCards at pokeapi.ts:96, speciesIndex at pokeapi.ts:172, which the home page passes to the card list via structural typing), so any new card field or change to card semantics is a three-site edit.
findings.suggestion: Route all card construction through toCards (or a single makeCard(species, pokemon) helper) and have getTeamData/speciesIndex use it, so CardData has one producer.

findings.issue: The sprite URL is derived in the view from the species ID (lib/format.ts:23) instead of being carried from the API's sprites.front_default; CardData has no sprite field, so a 'wrong sprite for Deoxys-like species' fix requires data plumbing through all three card producers, not a one-line change.
findings.suggestion: Add sprite: string | null to CardData, populate it from getPokemonById/sprites.front_default in the (single) card producer, and let PokemonCardList just render it.

findings.issue: The 'sort pokemon.types by slot, map to type names' logic is copy-pasted four times (functions.ts:65, 125, 156 and pokeapi.ts:196).
findings.suggestion: Extract a slotOrderedTypes(pokemon) helper in pokeapi.ts and use it everywhere.

findings.issue: Type labels have two sources of truth: an optional typeLabels map (rebuilt identically in routes/index.tsx:63 and routes/team.tsx:28) and a silent humanize(name) fallback; a page that renders types without passing the map would show humanized instead of English names.
findings.suggestion: Ship type labels with the card data (a TypeRef[] per card) or provide the label map from a single shared hook/loader, and drop the fallback.

findings.issue: head() branches on the underscore-prefixed internal match field m._notFound in addition to the public match.status === 'notFound'.
findings.suggestion: Rely on the documented match.status only; if notFound head is unreliable, set the title from the notFoundComponent path instead.

findings.issue: One 220-line file accumulates a bespoke mapper per page (getPokemonPage alone is ~75 lines); as resources are added (Items, Berries) it grows into the app's largest edit hotspot.
findings.suggestion: Split per-resource server functions into src/server/<resource>.ts files that re-export from an index, keeping functions.ts as a thin registry.

findings.issue: Caching rules are spread across files: server TTL in pokeapi.ts:6, but client staleTime in __root.tsx:11, index.tsx:31, team.tsx:13 and defaultPreload in router.tsx:9 — changing 'caching rules' means hunting five spots (the base URL itself is correctly single-sourced at pokeapi.ts:9).
findings.suggestion: Centralize route cache settings (e.g. shared staleTime constants or a router-level default with per-route overrides) next to the server TTL.

findings.issue: The file PokemonCard.tsx exports only PokemonCardList — filename/export mismatch adds grep friction, and lib/config.ts is a one-hook module misleadingly named 'config'.
findings.suggestion: Rename to PokemonCardList.tsx (or extract a single card component) and fold useMediaBase into a hooks module or the card list itself.

findings.issue: The app ships no tests or test runner of its own (0 test files); the only safety net is the external acceptance suite, so refactors like the ones above are verified only by manual runs.
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal Vitest/Playwright smoke setup for the shared helpers (format, coverage, toCards) before the next structural change.

summary: This is a well-seamed, current-stable TanStack Start codebase: all API access sits in one server-only module behind typed server functions, every card list renders through one component, and the later team feature was absorbed via a renderAction slot rather than copied markup. The main editability costs are duplicated data plumbing — CardData assembled in three places, slot-ordered type mapping copy-pasted four times — and a sprite URL derived in the view instead of carried from the data. Those are cheap to fix now and worth fixing before more resources are added.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: Four deletions, all of feature-named code: the route file, getAbilityPage + its import, getAbility/RawAbility, and the one Abilities Section on the Pokémon page; routeTree.gen.ts regenerates and no nav link exists. Clean, just not a single-directory delete.

scenarios.change: Fix wrong sprite for species whose default Pokémon differs (Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: The good news: one component (PokemonCard.tsx:25) renders every list, so the fix covers all lists at once. The bad news: the correct value is sprites.front_default, which CardData doesn't carry, so you must add the field and thread it through the three card producers (toCards, speciesIndex, getTeamData).

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: Cannot be done purely in PokemonCardList: the home page slices to a 48-card page before rendering (index.tsx:78), so the sort must happen on `matches` before pagination, while other lists can sort in the component or in toCards; the team page must opt out to preserve insertion order. Three coordinated edits.

scenarios.change: Add an Items section (/items, /items/:name) shaped like Moves
scenarios.notes: Logic reuse is high — memo/fetchJson layer, humanize/display/format helpers, Section, TypeBadge, NotFound, notFound() loader pattern and the srvx server all work untouched — but the page itself is bespoke per resource, so you copy the Moves route (~30 lines of thin boilerplate) plus a getItem/RawItem pair and a getItemPage mapper. No shared resource-page abstraction exists to extend.

scenarios.change: Change the API base URL and caching rules
scenarios.notes: The base URL is exemplary: one place (pokeapi.ts:9) with a single seam to the client via the root loader's mediaBase. The server cache TTL is also one place (pokeapi.ts:6). Client-side caching, however, is per-route staleTime in three routes plus defaultPreload in router.tsx, so 'caching rules' as a whole is a five-file sweep.
